limits: Injected evaluator success proves coordination only.
No actual browser/container/model execution was performed in this scope.
Captures compare complete file lists and identities; they are not an atomic filesystem snapshot.
Explicit lock recovery requires local-storage, same-host and quiescence confirmations.
Unrecognized legacy process start tokens are not resumed.
Power loss, remote synchronization and uncooperative code running with the same account are not guaranteed.
